name: SellToken router unchecked user-supplied settlement input
summary: The SellToken03 contract trusts a caller-supplied token/amount pair when settling a sale and never validates it against what was actually received, so the attacker had it pay out against a worthless input.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
